notes.title: Epic Battle Simulator 2 will be Free-to-Play!
notes.content:
🎉 Exciting News: Our Game will be Free-to-Play! 🎉

We’re thrilled to announce that Epic Battle Simulator 2 will be available to everyone—for free! This big change means that more players can jump into the action, try out new strategies, and experience the thrill of battle without any upfront cost.

Why the Change? We believe that the fun, challenge, and excitement of Epic Battle Simulator 2 should be accessible to as many people as possible. By making the game free, we’re opening up our community and giving all players the opportunity to be a part of the battlefield, where skill and strategy are the keys to victory.

Thank You for Your Support! To our existing players, thank you for supporting us from the start! Your loyalty and feedback have been invaluable, and we’re committed to making Epic Battle Simulator 2 better with each update.
